items.quote: Direct reports said that Liossa Osford contributed effectively to the partnership with sister agencies on youth services.
Direct reports said that Liossa Osford led evidence-based evaluation of programme outcomes across the department.
Several respondents noted that Liossa Osford was recognised sector-wide for his leadership of an ethics review of conflict-of-interest declarations.
Peers observed that Liossa championed coaching and mentoring junior officers and it became a model adopted by other agencies.
Peers observed that Liossa led cost savings across procurement across the department.
Several respondents noted that Liossa delivered his share of the redesign of the citizen journey for permits reliably.
Peers observed that Liossa Osford headed long-term strategy for the sector, setting priorities for several teams.
